newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian gunman escapes from PLO custody.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian gunman escapes from PLO custody.

text.p: A Palestinian jailed for life by a PLO court for killing a Jewish settler and her young son escaped on Tuesday from a hospital in the self-ruled West Bank town of Jericho, security officials said.
Abdel Nasser al-Qaisi, 20, was transferred to the hospital from prison three days ago for treatment of an ailment which Palestinian officials did not disclose. They said he escaped through a window.

A Palestinian security court had convicted Qaisi, along with another guerrilla and the driver of a getaway car, of killing Etta Tzur and her 12-year-old son Ephraim at the Beit El settlement near the West Bank town of Ramallah in December.
Qaisi and the second gunman were sentenced to life imprisonment at hard labour. The third man was jailed for 15 years.
The Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine, a radical PLO faction, claimed responsibility for the attack in which Tzur's car was sprayed with automatic weapons fire.
The security sources said Palestinian forces were looking for Qaisi inside Jericho and Israeli soldiers were searching for him outside the self-ruled enclave.
